Navigate Goat Simulator 3 with a game-playing agent
Gemini-powered SIMA 2 navigates Goat Simulator 3, and a human player can direct it to improve its performance.
Done with
GE
Gemini
What they did
Google DeepMind built SIMA 2, a Gemini-powered agent that moves around the world of Goat Simulator 3. It is meant to learn and adapt in open-ended, complicated games. A human player can direct it and help improve its performance. The article gives no detail on the mechanics.
How it went
The source states no results or numbers. It only reports that the agent is navigating Goat Simulator 3 and that human direction can improve it.
Worth knowing
The article is a brief secondhand report of MIT Technology Review's coverage and has no setup details, so check that original piece before trying to copy this.
Try it yourself
with
Gemini
Copy prompt
I have [game name] running on this desktop. Navigate the world using the keyboard and mouse to reach [destination or goal], and I'll give you extra directions as you go, such as [example instruction]. Check in with me whenever you get stuck, and stop when you've reached the goal or after [number] minutes.
Original source: https://www.aol.com/articles/google-training-gemini-powered-agents-160440480.html
